title: Approved changes round: Test Panel pagination, file-based Bulk Range Import, Provider Rate visibility, Admin Provider filter, Provider/Range summary

scope_safety.exportWorker_change: single additive line: numbers export honours the existing provider filter (r.provider = ?) so a filtered table exports the same filtered rows

new_api_routes.purpose: download the bulk range import sample (format=csv|xlsx|txt); generated from the same column spec the importer accepts

parse + validate a whole CSV/XLSX/XLS/TXT file, then create/update ranges in one transaction using the existing range columns and normalizers; returns total/valid/invalid/imported/updated/skipped/errors rows
server-side GROUP BY aggregation: ranges (name + provider + number count) and per-provider totals (ranges, numbers) incl. registry providers with zero ranges

existing_routes_extended_additively.added: ?ranges_only=1 returns only the distinct range names of the active test pool (for the Test Panel range dropdown without loading the pool)
?range=<range name> optional filter (additive; empty = previous behaviour). Paged mode already existed.
?provider=<name> admin-only filter (numbers -> ranges.provider); admin responses additionally expose provider_name + provider_rate (stored value for the row payment cycle)
admin responses additionally expose provider_name + provider_rate (stored ranges.provider_rate_* for the SMS payment cycle). Non-admin responses unchanged (no provider fields at all).
?ids_only=1 returns ONLY {ids,total,cap,capped} for the same role-scoped filter set (used by Select-All across filtered pages — no row data is loaded into the browser)
accepts the optional provider filter and passes it to the existing export worker allowlist (numbers type only)

provider_rate.source: ranges.provider_rate_1_1 / provider_rate_7_1 / provider_rate_7_7 / provider_rate_30_45 (existing columns, existing values)
provider_rate.selection: the column matching the row payment cycle (daily -> 1/1, weekly_7_1 -> 7/1, weekly_7_7 -> 7/7, monthly_30x45 -> 30/45)

provider_filter.semantics: shows every eligible number of the provider across ALL of its ranges; combines with Range, Owner, search, allocation filter and sorting; Select All covers the filtered result page
provider_filter.select_all: page-scoped by default; when the filters match more rows than the page shows the admin is asked once and can select ALL matching numbers across pages (ids-only server query). Selection is cleared whenever the filters/pagination change.
provider_filter.export_parity: CSV export button sends the same filters (search/range/provider/owner/allocation)

provider_summary_page.counts_source: SQLite GROUP BY (server-side); the browser never receives number rows for counting
provider_summary_page.export: CSV (client-side export of the aggregated rows only)

test_panel_pagination.filters: search, range filter and CLI filter are sent to the server so page counts stay exact; the 4s poll keeps the current page

validations: rate / provider rate decimal or NA (max 6 decimals)
range start/end digits and start <= end
unsupported file format / empty file / missing Range Name header
unknown provider name -> warning (the Add Range form itself accepts free-text providers)
bulk_range_import.atomicity: whole file parsed and validated first; writes run inside one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction with rollback on failure
bulk_range_import.sample_csv_bom: CSV/XLSX/TXT samples include a UTF-8 BOM (Excel-friendly); the importer strips it on read

test_results.p19k_api_suite: 80 PASS / 0 FAIL (idempotent — re-runs green; creates+removes its own ranges)

regressions.smoke-all-panels: 51 pages / 0 JS errors / 0 write API calls

test_results.fixture: fresh isolated fixture: 3 ranges, 35 live numbers, 62 test numbers (3 pages), 65 test SMS (page 3 = 15), 3 providers (one with no ranges), 7 users; rebuilt with galaxy-ui-work/reseed-fixture.sh

apply: copy the 6 changed files over the v5/v4 install (admin.html, agent.html, client.html, management.html, test.html, backend/server.js) and restart the backend. No DB migration, no config change.
